info.name: Gazebo - Stock Reports
info.description:
Sage-style stock criteria reports backed by `stock_entry`, plus daily closing-stock email recipients (AWS SES).

**Domain:** goods in (receipts), goods out (issues), closing stock as-of date, operator activity (manager day overview), report email recipients.

**Tables:** `stock_entry`, `stock_entry_posting`, `stock_entry_label_scan`, `rbac_user`; `stock_report_email_recipient`.

**Vars:** `{{base_url}}`, `{{date_from}}`, `{{date_to}}`, `{{as_of}}`, `{{date}}`, `{{from_time}}`, `{{user_id}}`, `{{product_id}}`, `{{location_id}}`, `{{recipient_id}}`

request.description:
### Goods in report

`GET /stock/reports/goods-in/`

Lists posted **receipt** stock movements whose business date (`effective_at`) falls between `date_from` and `date_to` (inclusive). Use from a criteria popup like Sage Day Books: pick a date range, optionally filter raw materials (`goods_in_type=raw_material`), then OK.

Example: `date_from=2026-08-01` & `date_to=2026-08-20` returns every live goods-in line in that window.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date_from` | yes | Start date `YYYY-MM-DD` (inclusive) |
| `date_to` | yes | End date `YYYY-MM-DD` (inclusive) |
| `goods_in_type` | no | `raw_material`, `packaging`, or `other`. Alias: `product_type` |
| `product_id` | no | Filter one product |
| `location_id` | no | Filter one warehouse/location |
| `limit` | no | Max rows, default 200, max 1000 |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status: "success", message: "Goods in report fetched.", data: { date_from, date_to, count, results: [ { entry_id, entry_type, effective_at, recorded_at, product_id, product_name, recipe_code, gff_code, goods_in_type, lot_id, trace_number, use_by, location_id, location_name, counterparty_location_id, counterparty_location_name, quantity, quantity_base, unit_id, unit_name, source_document_type, source_document_id, po_number, remarks, product_supplier_id, supplier_code, sage_product_code, supplier_product_name, shape_format_label, pack_quantity, pack_unit_name, display_kg } ] } }`

Each movement/closing row also includes supplier pack fields when a `product_supplier` mapping is known: `product_supplier_id`, `supplier_code`, `sage_product_code`, `supplier_product_name`, `shape_format_label`, `pack_quantity`, `pack_unit_name`, `display_kg`. Mass uses existing `quantity_base` / `display_kg` (no separate grams field).

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success (including empty `results`) |
| 400 | Missing/invalid dates, inverted range, bad `goods_in_type` / ids |

### Goods out report

`GET /stock/reports/goods-out/`

Lists posted **issue** stock movements in the `effective_at` date range (inclusive). Same criteria shape as goods in. Does **not** include disposal, transfer, or production consumption — issues only.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date_from` | yes | Start date `YYYY-MM-DD` (inclusive) |
| `date_to` | yes | End date `YYYY-MM-DD` (inclusive) |
| `goods_in_type` | no | `raw_material`, `packaging`, or `other`. Alias: `product_type` |
| `product_id` | no | Filter one product |
| `location_id` | no | Filter one location |
| `limit` | no | Max rows, default 200, max 1000 |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status: "success", message: "Goods out report fetched.", data: { date_from, date_to, count, results: [ …same movement row shape as goods in… ] } }`

Issue / transfer_out quantities are negative in the ledger; `pack_quantity` / `display_kg` use absolute mass for warehouse display.

Each movement/closing row also includes supplier pack fields when a `product_supplier` mapping is known: `product_supplier_id`, `supplier_code`, `sage_product_code`, `supplier_product_name`, `shape_format_label`, `pack_quantity`, `pack_unit_name`, `display_kg`. Mass uses existing `quantity_base` / `display_kg` (no separate grams field).

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 400 | Missing/invalid dates, inverted range, bad filters |

query.description: Closing date YYYY-MM-DD (balance through end of that day)
1/true to keep zero qty rows (default omit zeros)

request.description:
### Closing stock report

`GET /stock/reports/closing-stock/`

Returns lot×location closing balances **as of end of** `as_of` (23:59:59 local). Sums posted `stock_entry.quantity` where `effective_at` ≤ that cutoff. Use a single date picker in the criteria popup (Sage-style “as of” / day close).

Zero balances are omitted unless `include_zero=1`. Queued/cancelled receipts and downtime rows are excluded.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `as_of` | yes | Closing date `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `goods_in_type` | no | `raw_material`, `packaging`, or `other`. Alias: `product_type` |
| `product_id` | no | Filter one product |
| `location_id` | no | Filter one location |
| `include_zero` | no | Include zero qty rows when `1` / `true` / `yes` |
| `view` | no | `detail` (default) = one row per lot×location with `use_by` / `trace_number`. `consolidated` = rollup by product × shape with `earliest_use_by` / `latest_use_by`, `lot_count`, `location_count` |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status: "success", message: "Closing stock report fetched.", data: { as_of, view, group_by, count, results: [ … ] } }`

**`view=detail` (default)** — one row per lot×location:

`{ as_of, product_id, product_name, recipe_code, gff_code, goods_in_type, lot_id, trace_number, use_by, location_id, location_name, unit_id, unit_name, quantity, quantity_base, product_supplier_id, supplier_code, sage_product_code, supplier_product_name, shape_format_label, pack_quantity, pack_unit_name, display_kg }`

`use_by` is that lot’s best-before / use-by date.

**`view=consolidated`** — one row per product × `product_supplier` shape (no lot/trace/location):

`{ as_of, product_id, product_name, recipe_code, gff_code, goods_in_type, unit_id, unit_name, product_supplier_id, supplier_code, sage_product_code, supplier_product_name, shape_format_label, pack_quantity, pack_unit_name, quantity, quantity_base, display_kg, earliest_use_by, latest_use_by, lot_count, location_count }`

`earliest_use_by` / `latest_use_by` = soonest and latest best-before across lots in the group. Nightly email CSV stays on detail grain.

Each row includes supplier pack fields when a `product_supplier` mapping is known. Mass uses `quantity_base` / `display_kg` (no separate grams field).

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 400 | Missing/invalid `as_of` or bad filters |

query.description: Calendar day YYYY-MM-DD (local TZ, on recorded_at / queued_at / scanned_at)

request.description:
### Operator activity report

`GET /stock/reports/operator-activity/`

Manager day overview of who worked stock: entry counts by type, label scans, stock-in postings (posted vs queued in the window), and per-operator breakdown with display names from `rbac_user`. Use when reviewing a live stock-take shift (e.g. opening stock from 14:14 UK).

Times apply in the server timezone (Europe/London in prod). Counts use `stock_entry.recorded_at`, `stock_entry_posting.queued_at`, and `stock_entry_label_scan.scanned_at`.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | yes | Day `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `from_time` | no | Start `HH:MM` (default `00:00`) |
| `to_time` | no | End `HH:MM` inclusive (default `23:59`) |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status: "success", message: "Operator activity fetched.", data: { date, from_time, to_time, timezone, summary: { users, entries, receipts, products, locations, transfers_in, transfers_out, scans_ok, scans_mismatch, postings_posted, postings_queued, still_queued_now }, operators: [ { user_id, display_name, entries, receipts, transfers, scans, queued } ] } }`

`operators[].queued` is that person's **current** still-queued stock-in count (not limited to the window). `summary.still_queued_now` is the global still-queued total.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success (including empty operators) |
| 400 | Missing/invalid `date` or times, or `from_time` after `to_time` |

### Operator activity detail

`GET /stock/reports/operator-activity/detail/`

Drill-down for one operator: their `stock_entry` lines in the same day/time window as the summary report (newest first). Same movement row shape as goods-in/out reports. Tap a person on the manager screen, then load this.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | yes | Day `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `user_id` | yes | Operator `rbac_user` id |
| `from_time` | no | Start `HH:MM` (default `00:00`) |
| `to_time` | no | End `HH:MM` inclusive (default `23:59`) |
| `limit` | no | Max rows, default 200, max 1000 |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status: "success", message: "Operator activity detail fetched.", data: { date, from_time, to_time, user_id, display_name, count, results: [ { entry_id, entry_type, effective_at, recorded_at, product_id, product_name, … } ] } }`

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 400 | Missing `date` / `user_id`, or invalid times |

### List report email recipients

`GET /stock/reports/email-recipients/`

Returns every address that can receive the nightly closing-stock CSV (AWS SES). Used by the frontend settings screen that configures who gets the daily report.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status: "success", message: "Report email recipients fetched.", data: [ { id, email, is_active, created_at, updated_at } ] }`

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 401 | Missing/invalid token |
| 403 | Not an admin |

### Add report email recipient

`POST /stock/reports/email-recipients/`

Adds an email to the daily closing-stock distribution list. Stored lowercased; must be unique. New rows start `is_active=true` and are included the next time `manage.py email_closing_stock_report` runs.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | yes | Valid email address |

**Response body**

`{ status: "success", message: "Report email recipient added.", data: { id, email, is_active, created_at, updated_at } }`

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | Created |
| 400 | Missing/invalid email |
| 401 | Missing/invalid token |
| 403 | Not an admin |
| 409 | Email already on the list |

### Update report email recipient

`PATCH /stock/reports/email-recipients/:id/`

Toggle whether a recipient gets the nightly closing-stock email, or change the address. Inactive addresses stay in the list but are skipped by the SES command.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Recipient PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `is_active` | yes | `true` / `false` |
| `email` | no | New address if changing |

**Response body**

`{ status: "success", message: "Report email recipient updated.", data: { id, email, is_active, created_at, updated_at } }`

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Updated |
| 400 | Missing `is_active` or invalid email |
| 401 | Missing/invalid token |
| 403 | Not an admin |
| 404 | Unknown id |
| 409 | Email already on the list |

### Delete report email recipient

`DELETE /stock/reports/email-recipients/:id/`

Removes an address from the daily closing-stock distribution list permanently.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Recipient PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status: "success", message: "Report email recipient removed.", data: { ref: <id> } }`

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Removed |
| 401 | Missing/invalid token |
| 403 | Not an admin |
| 404 | Unknown id |
